source.rationale: Literal grouping, labels and values from specialized Figma specification sheets; these outrank generic geometry statistics.

semantic.rationale: Engineering roles alias source tokens or record explicitly justified accessible-text decisions. Unrelated component-only state paints and geometry are not promoted into this layer.

color.rationale: Source Gray 200 and 25% Dark Blue remain preserved source facts. The accessible production text roles extend the observed Dark Blue opacity family to 60% as a repository decision so active supporting and placeholder text meets WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 on supported library surfaces.

status-foreground.rationale: Six additive production foreground roles preserve their corresponding source hue families while raising active-text contrast. Each is a source-derived whole-percentage darkening that reaches at least a 4.75:1 engineering margin on the supported white, Gray 50, Blue 50, and page surfaces; the public threshold is 4.5:1. Source foregrounds, all backgrounds, geometry, and the already-compliant blue, source-blue, and purple foregrounds remain unchanged. These roles are not source facts or business-state meanings.

font.source: raw/typography-UI Kit – Basic elements.json and raw/typography-UI Kit – Interface elements.json
font.rationale: Golos Text is a source-backed product family. The ordered runtime stack is an engineering decision because the repository contains no distributable font files or font package.

typography.source: raw typography exports and component SVGs
typography.rationale: Golos remains the source-authoritative default. Fira Sans is an official compatibility profile. Shared role aliases preserve the existing source-derived Golos metrics and component geometry.
